title: Water Babies
subtitle: An Interactive Art Installation in Dialogue with Fluid Intelligence
summary: An immersive installation that translates human presence and voice into a real-time dialogue of fluid imagery, light and sound.
body: Set in 2123 aboard a speculative spacecraft orbiting Kepler-138b, Water Babies imagines humanity’s first contact with a microscopic aquatic hive mind. Audiences address the organism through a wireless sensing system; a custom translation pipeline maps their presence and voice into real-time fluid imagery, light and sound, while the entity’s shifting responses form a non-verbal dialogue. By reducing language to frequency, movement and fluctuation, the installation asks whether understanding—or empathy—can emerge beyond human semantics.
